description: This file provides a wrapper for non-cryptographic message digest functions, including implementations of the DJB hash (djb2a) and a variant inspired by Donald E. Knuth's algorithms. It defines inline functions for hashing strings with these algorithms.

methods.name: uint32_t djbhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a DJB hash for a given string segment.

methods.name: uint32_t dekhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a hash based on Knuth's algorithm for a given string segment.

ctags.name: dekhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t dekhash (const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/

ctags.name: djbhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t djbhash(const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/
